title: Surgical cutting and repositioning guides for minimally invasive orthognathic surgery: a retrospective comparative cohort study of bilateral sagittal split osteotomy
html: Customized surgical guides may improve the accuracy of minimally invasive orthognathic surgery, particularly in facilitating the transfer of three-dimensional virtual surgical planning (3D-VSP) to the operative setting. This retrospective comparative cohort study included patients undergoing bimaxillary surgery with simultaneous genioplasty. Fifty consecutive patients were assessed for eligibility during the study period between January and July 2024. Fourteen were excluded (seven initial implementation phase; seven class III deformity), leaving 36 patients for final analysis.
